description: The workspace webview shows the ship-served lattice client (any user-configured URL, so the pattern is any host). It gets exactly two things: pick_upload, which opens a native dialog and returns only what the user picked (a hostile page gets nothing without the user choosing files in a visible OS dialog), and open-external-url, so target=_blank links (the clearweb share link) reach the system browser. That command refuses anything outside http, https, mailto and tel, enforced in rust rather than in the page.
